claims.text: The baseline system used for comparison is a one-stage RNN system with a 2-layer BLSTM structure trained to recognize dialect categories.
The baseline system is outperformed by both the two-stage and three-stage systems, which are trained with phonetic sequence annotation and dialect category labels.
The two-stage system shows a 10% increase in accuracy on every task compared to the baseline system.
